Emma (Partnerships): Heads-up — our HW SI partner wants to go live in Marketplace next month. Marketing is pushing a joint press announce for 2025-06-10. Need final security evidence (SOC2 summary, pen-test witness report, questionnaire answers, firmware attestation) by EOD 2025-05-20. Can security confirm cut-off and upload location? @Raj
Raj (Security): That's tight but doable. We need SOC2 (Type II) PDF + redaction log, pen-test report with scope and signed attestation, signed questionnaire CSV, and firmware attestation. Upload to s3://marketplace-evidence/sis/partner-xyz/ using the ingest form so we get asset IDs. I'll post exact filenames in a sec.
Mike (SI): Pen-test vendor is available 2025-05-08 → 2025-05-12 for a witness window. We can prioritize web surface + firmware. Want regression retest for the CVEs we flagged last quarter?
Olivia (Product): Marketing freeze until evidence validated. If security hasn't signed off by 2025-05-21 COB we should move the press date. Need final go/no-go by 2025-05-21 18:00 UTC.
Raj (Security): Required artifacts (minimal):
- SOC2 Type II PDF (attestation + scope pages)
- Pen-test full report (redacted PII) + signed tester attestation
- Vendor questionnaire (signed PDF/CSV)
- Firmware attestation signed by HW partner (hash + metadata)
- Signed data-flow diagram and retention policy doc
- Presigned S3 manifest with SHA256 checksums for all uploaded artifacts
I'll also need a short test harness with sample prompts to run quick safety/quality checks.
Emma (Partnerships): Got it. Where do we drop the presigned URLs — ingest form or straight S3?
Kyle (Docs): Use the ingest form so Asset IDs map to the listing and automate retention flags. Ingest: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/ingest (requires SSO). After ingest the aws presign step is:
```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/sis/partner-xyz/SOC2-2025-05-01.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Include a file manifest JSON alongside.
compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence deadline 2025-05-20 17:00 UTC for thread 1745678901. Missing artifacts will trigger a listing hold. :warning:
Mike (SI): We'll book the pen vendor for 2025-05-09 and ask for a regression retest. I'll post the scheduling link and vendor contact in this thread once confirmed.
Emma (Partnerships): tagging @Olivia @Mike — please confirm press move if all green. Also need linkage for marketplace listing id to include in the announcement doc.
Raj (Security): Also require E2E smoke evals against the deployed endpoint + output-safety checklist run. Add a small eval set (10 prompts) that we can run post-deploy.
Olivia (Product): Noted. I'll prepare comms and a dry-run for announce messaging on 2025-05-23. If security signs off earlier we can accelerate the messaging review.
Emma (Partnerships): Locking dates: evidence cutoff = 2025-05-20 17:00 UTC, go/no-go = 2025-05-21 COB, announce target = 2025-06-10. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
